item.title: HPD investigates possible murder-suicide at downtown Houston high-rise
item.description: Police are investigating the discovery of a dead man and woman in downtown Houston that investigators believe was a murder-suicide.

item.title: 8-year-old Houstonian danced in Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl show
item.description: At just 8 years old, JoeRuben Garcia is already making big moves – his dancing earned him a spot in Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl halftime show.

item.title: Houston native stars as ‘grass’ in Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: If you’re wondering what it was like to be part of the Benito Bowl - aka Bad Bunny's Super Bowl halftime show, one Houstonian can give you the details!

item.title: Texas A&M student Brianna Aguilera's death was suicide, medical examiner's report says
item.description: A Texas A&M student who fell off a West Campus high rise in Austin on Nov. 29, 2025 had died by suicide, according to a report released Friday by the Travis County Medical Examiner's Office.

item.title: Historic Freedmen's Town bricks damaged by contractor again
item.description: Choranda Johnson, mayor of Freedmen’s Town, said the historic bricks were damaged after a contractor began work to connect water meters without notifying community leaders.

item.title: HISD to close 12 campuses beginning Fall 2026
item.description: Houston ISD plans to close 12 campuses due to declining enrollment and rising maintenance costs. Impacted students and staff will receive support.

item.title: Gas leak close Sienna Parkway in Fort Bend County, officials say
item.description: Sienna Parkway is closed from Sienna Ranch Road to Steep Bank Trace until further notice, city officials said.

item.title: Teenage boy shot in possible drive-by shooting in northeast Houston, HPD says
item.description: A 15-year-old boy was shot in a possible drive-by shooting in northeast Houston, police said.

item.title: Severe thunderstorms on tap for Saturday that could cause flooding
item.description: Patchy fog and sea fog remain the biggest weather impacts this week as Southeast Texas stays warm and humid, with limited rain chances through midweek.

item.title: 3 detained as SWAT team searches property in Nancy Guthrie investigation
item.description: Authorities swarmed the home near Guthrie’s Tucson area neighborhood as part of a search warrant execution.
